title: Pack replaces the package file already at its output whole, through its temporary file, and leaves nothing else beside it
notes: The setup puts an earlier file at out/replace-1.0.0.metais. After the pack, out holds the new package alone: the old bytes are gone, and the temporary file .metais-tmp-<h> it was written through was renamed over them. The expected package was written by metais pack and is compared by entries.
